components.css: .ds-ficha{background:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #d9dde4,0 1px 2px rgb(8 38 77/.06),0 6px 18px -8px rgb(8 38 77/.18);font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;color:#14213a}.ds-ficha h3{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px;color:#08264d}.ds-ficha dl{margin:0;border-top:1px solid #d9dde4}.ds-ficha div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:6.5rem 1fr;gap:12px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d9dde4}.ds-ficha dt{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6a7489}.ds-ficha dd{margin:0;font-family:Alegreya,serif;font-size:16px}
